correctness.rationale: Every input word belongs to exactly one of eighteen explicit 5-parent deletion-output cliques. This proves the bound 18. Every finite domain and deletion operation is explicitly generated; no unverified infinite inference or timeout is used.

value.rationale: The composition (2,2,2) is the first genuinely repeated perfectly balanced type for the ternary alphabet. Its complete eight-code equality structure is not a textbook numerical substitution: all optimizers share twelve mandatory words and form an exact three-binary-choice family. The strict chromatic gap of 6 over clique number 5 demonstrates a structural barrier to extending binary constant-weight optimal-coloring behavior. The theorem is finite, natural and self-contained without claiming asymptotic consequences.
